scenarios.title: Step ground: the Smith dies, the room is clear, the bot clicks the Malus stand and carries the Malus
scenarios.provenance: CHEATED: warped into the Barracks (debug goto 28), the chunk accepted in the plan store, record 3 = 0x000c (started), clvl 24 stand-in with 400 life, merc level 17 (devp23 labverbs), monsters by debug spawn. Mechanics only, never evidence about balance or the live hero.
scenarios.notes: Smith spawned (plain), the stand added beside the hero by `debug object add 108` (devp25 stepverbs), quest 3 = 0x000c (the stand refuses a hero without the quest). The bot's stand click is toolstrade34 (merged). Control: .control (no Smith, no stand, no click: no hdm). Needs the devp25 binary (PG_D2D_BIN).

assert.why: the bot clicked the Malus stand (object 108) and carries the Malus (the d2d drops it only from the stand, devp24 doc)

scenarios.title: Step ground: a Malus lies in the Barracks, the bot picks it up
scenarios.provenance: CHEATED: warped into the Barracks (debug goto 28), the chunk accepted in the plan store, record 3 = 0x000c (started), clvl 24 stand-in with 400 life, merc level 17 (devp23 labverbs), monsters by debug spawn. Mechanics only, never evidence about balance or the live hero.
scenarios.notes: The pickup half of Tools of the Trade, apart from the kill: the Malus is given at the hero's feet in the Barracks (debug give hdm 2, SETUP). U: whether the bot's loot picks a quest item at once or only inside the boss script. A RED here is a bot finding; GREEN says nothing about the drop (step.act1.smith.stand_click_pickup, pending on fork verb F2). First run (V, run 20261123-175729, no monsters): RED, the bot never clicked the ground Malus while the boss script ran (loot sweeps follow fights): two Fallen are spawned so a fight, then a loot sweep, happens. Second run (V, run 20261123-175828): RED again, the leveling plan walked the hero toward Tower Cellar 3 before the board started and no loot line names the Malus; the scenario now farms the Barracks so the bot fights and loots where the Malus lies. Third run (V, run 20261123-175917, Paladin 11): GREEN, log 'loot: clicked item=Horadric Malus', 'Found Horadric Malus', hdm in the pack.

assert.why: the bot clicked the dropped Malus (log is the bot's report, S)
the Malus is carried at the end (V design: a quest item is not sold or dropped by this chunk before Charsi)
